cyclic_induction.actual: Base case and induction step proved at length 100
cyclic_induction.scope: Unbounded cyclic normal transactions in the synchronous/async2sync model, with fresh arbitrary allowed payload/mode for each transaction.

quantification: Bounded two-transaction models and an unbounded cyclic synchronous protocol model; arbitrary allowed stable 32-bit word/mode per transaction plus arbitrary extraction MOSI. Only the disclosed encryption-word case is excluded.
compositional_argument: No XOR mask under these conditions plus unchanged inputs to the same recovered core implies equal sampled outputs for coupled core state. The core itself is abstracted, not cryptographically verified.
limits: Explicit-edge model is bounded to 325 global samples; unbounded cyclic proof uses the synchronous async2sync model.
Reset, full frames, stable mode, prescribed launch/readout sequence are assumptions.
No claim for malformed frames, arbitrary clock/control glitches, metastability, real board timing, or cipher identity.
Negative controls intentionally permit existing disclosed fault behavior; no new behavior is generated.
